queries: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount FROM ev, overall WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.overall_avg), above_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS m FROM above) SELECT a.link_to_event, a.avg_amount, a.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS beat_overall_avg, a.avg_amount - am.m AS gap_from_above_mean FROM above a, overall o, above_mean am ORDER BY gap_from_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average budget amount is the mean of amount across all budget lines (non-null amounts), not the mean of per-event averages.
Budget lines with a NULL link_to_event are excluded from the per-event grouping, but non-null amounts on them still count in the overall average.
The 'mean among those above-average events' is the simple average of the above-average events' per-event average amounts.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the mean of the per-event averages (each event weighted equally), instead of the mean over all budget lines.

assumptions.assumption: The 'overall average budget amount' is the average of amount across all budget lines (NULL amounts ignored), not the average of the per-event averages.
Budget lines with a NULL link_to_event are not treated as an event and are left out of the per-event results.
'Above-average' means the event's average amount is strictly greater than the overall average. The 'mean among those above-average events' is the mean of their per-event averages.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the mean of the per-event average amounts, so each event counts equally instead of each budget line.

The mean among above-average events is the simple mean of those events' average amounts.
